books.title: Lava Golem

books.shortText: Discard a hand book; gain its Value here.
books.rulesText: On Assign: discard a random other book from your hand. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to that book's current Value.

rebinds.name: Convincing Mimic
rebinds.text: Printed Value 4.

rebinds.name: Perfect Mimicry
rebinds.text: On Assign: discard a random other book from your hand. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to twice that book's current Value.

rebinds.name: Replacement Loot
rebinds.text: On Assign: discard a random other book from your hand. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to its current Value. Then draw 1 book.

books.title: Saurian Empire
books.shortText: DESTROY a book here; gain its Value again.
books.rulesText: On Assign: DESTROY another book assigned to this visitor. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to that book's current Value.
books.flavor: A study of the ancient saurian dominions: brutal civilizations in which monstrous reptilian rulers consumed everything beneath them and turned conquest into renewed strength.

rebinds.name: Imperial Edition
rebinds.text: Printed Value 4.

rebinds.name: Total Conquest
rebinds.text: On Assign: DESTROY another book assigned to this visitor. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to twice that book's current Value.

rebinds.name: Saurian Supremacy
rebinds.text: On Assign: DESTROY all other books assigned to this visitor. This visitor gains Fulfillment equal to the sum of their current Values.

books.title: Dragon Compendium
books.shortText: Draw 1. If it is as big as this: +1 forever, max 7.
books.rulesText: On Assign: draw 1 book. If its current Value is equal to or greater than Dragon Compendium's current Value, Dragon Compendium permanently gains +1 Value, to a maximum of 7.

rebinds.name: Expanded Compendium

rebinds.name: Comparative Dracology
rebinds.text: On Assign: draw 2 books. If the higher current Value of the two is at least Dragon Compendium's, Dragon Compendium permanently gains +1 Value, to a maximum of 7.

rebinds.name: Broad Criteria
rebinds.text: On Assign: draw 1 book. If its current Value is at least Dragon Compendium's current Value − 2, Dragon Compendium permanently gains +1 Value, to a maximum of 7.

books.title: Eclipse of the Werebeasts

rebinds.name: Blood Moon
rebinds.text: On Assign: 2 random books in your hand each become a Werebeast until the end of the Encounter, whose Value is its current Value +4. Once played, this book is DESTROYed for the rest of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Total Eclipse
rebinds.text: On Assign: 3 random books in your hand each become a Werebeast until the end of the Encounter, whose Value is its current Value +2. Once played, this book is DESTROYed for the rest of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Lingering Eclipse
rebinds.text: On Assign: 2 random books in your hand each become a Werebeast until the end of the Encounter, whose Value is its current Value +2. This copy is not DESTROYed after being played.

books.title: Monsters of the Deep
books.shortText: Tentacles assign 1 hand book, free, then DESTROY it.

rebinds.name: Deeper Still
rebinds.text: Printed Value 4.

rebinds.name: More Tentacles
rebinds.text: On Assign: tentacles take 2 random books from your hand and assign them to randomly chosen valid visitors for 0 Actions. Then DESTROY them.

rebinds.name: Guided Tentacles
rebinds.after: A hand book of your choice
rebinds.text: On Assign: choose a book from your hand. Tentacles assign it to a randomly chosen valid visitor for 0 Actions. Then DESTROY it.

rebinds.name: Never Lost
rebinds.text: If discarded or DESTROYed by an effect, it gains +2 Value and is assigned to a random valid visitor instead. If there is none, it returns to your hand instead.

books.title: Whispers of Blackwater
books.shortText: Return a random discarded book; +1 Value this Encounter.
books.rulesText: On Assign: return 1 random book from your discard pile to your hand. It gains +1 Value until the end of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Louder Whispers
rebinds.text: On Assign: return 1 random book from your discard pile to your hand. It gains +3 Value until the end of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Many Voices
rebinds.text: On Assign: return 2 random different books from your discard pile to your hand. Each gains +1 Value until the end of the Encounter.

rebinds.name: Blackwater Passage
rebinds.text: On Assign: return the highest-Value book from your discard pile to your hand. It gains +1 Value until the end of the Encounter.

books.title: The Tide of Teeth
books.shortText: Value = books in discard, max 4.
books.rulesText: This book's Value is equal to the number of books in your discard pile, to a maximum of 4.

rebinds.text: This book's Value is equal to the number of books in your discard pile, to a maximum of 6.

rebinds.name: Blood in the Water

books.title: The Starless Sea

rebinds.text: On Assign: this visitor is turned to stone. At the next End Turn they lose no Patience. Draw 1 book.

books.rulesText: On Assign: this visitor gains +1 Patience. Draw 1 book.

rebinds.text: On Assign: this visitor gains +2 Patience. Draw 1 book.

rebinds.name: Deeper Lights
rebinds.text: On Assign: this visitor gains +1 Patience. Draw 2 books.

rebinds.text: On Assign: this visitor gains +2 Patience. At your next Turn Start, if they are still waiting, they gain +1 Patience and 1 Fulfillment.

rebinds.text: On Assign: this visitor gains +1 Patience. At your next Turn Start they gain +1 Patience, and at every Turn Start while they wait, 1 Fulfillment.

books.title: Werebeast
books.shortText: No ability.
books.rulesText: A book transformed by Eclipse of the Werebeasts. It has no ability and turns back when the Encounter ends.

books.title: The Drowned One
books.shortText: Unplayable.
books.rulesText: You cannot assign this book from your hand, except to The Old Captain.
books.flavor: Somebody has already written your name inside the cover.

books.title: Rot
books.shortText: In your hand at End Turn → another Rot.
books.rulesText: If this book is still in your hand at End Turn, another Rot goes into your discard pile with it.
books.flavor: The pages are soft, and getting softer.

books.title: Traded Book
books.shortText: Once played, DESTROYed.
books.rulesText: Once played, this book is DESTROYed for the rest of the Encounter.
books.flavor: Somebody else's idea of a fair trade.

books.title: Molded Copy
books.shortText: Into your discard pile → DESTROYed.
books.rulesText: Whenever this book would enter your discard pile, it is DESTROYed instead.
books.flavor: It was buried with him. He insists you have it.

books.title: A Good Story
books.shortText: 2 Fulfillment if their first book.
books.rulesText: If this visitor has no other books assigned, this visitor gains 2 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Underjade Colorings
curios.text: Books assigned to a visitor on the turn that visitor arrives gain +1 Value.

curios.name: Talisman of Anger
curios.text: Books assigned to a visitor at 1 Patience gain +1 Value.

curios.name: Hypnotic Necklace
curios.text: A Merchant's Curio box costs 150 Gold instead of 200 and shows three Curios instead of two, and the first time you refresh their wares at each Merchant it is free.

curios.name: Talisman of the After-After Life
curios.text: Whenever your discard pile is shuffled into your Library, a random book shuffled in gains +1 Value until the end of the Encounter.

curios.name: Gold Ink
curios.text: Whenever you fulfill a visitor exactly at their Need, gain 3 Gold.

curios.name: Lost Tome
curios.text: When two books in a row played from your hand use your two different Traits, the third book gains +1 Value.

curios.name: Staff of Dominance
curios.text: Books assigned to visitors who have a visitor ability gain +1 Value.

curios.name: Lovely Waiting Stew
curios.text: The first time each Encounter that 4 or more visitors are waiting at the start of a turn, they all gain +1 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Occult Riddle
curios.text: After you have fulfilled 20 visitors while carrying it, gain a Rare Summon and destroy this Curio.

curios.name: Timelock Amber
curios.text: The first time each Encounter that you fulfill a visitor on the turn they arrive, gain +1 Action and draw 1 next turn.

curios.name: Euphoric Salts
curios.text: At the start of each turn, one random waiting visitor gains +1 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Dreamscythes
curios.text: Every 100 books shuffled from your discard pile into your Library while you carry this gain you +1 Reputation. The count carries across Encounters.

curios.name: The Volume II
curios.text: Basic books gain +1 Value.

curios.name: Orb of the Storms
curios.text: Every 3rd alternation in a row between your two Traits on paid assignments gains you +1 Action. A neutral book breaks the chain.

curios.name: Empyrean Wax
curios.text: While 4 or more visitors are waiting, every book gains +1 Value.

curios.name: Animating Chains
curios.text: Once a visitor holds a book of each of your two Traits, every further book assigned to them gives +1 Fulfillment more.

curios.name: Orb of Remorse
curios.text: When a visitor's ability lowers a book's Value, or discards or DESTROYs one of your books, books you assign to that visitor gain +1 Value for the rest of the Encounter.

curios.name: Queue Delicacies
curios.text: Whenever you fulfill a visitor while 4 or more others are still waiting, gain 5 Gold.

curios.name: Lost Epochs Ring
curios.text: Once per Encounter: the moment every waiting visitor has a book assigned, draw 1 extra book at random from your discard pile next turn.

curios.name: Pastlife Relic
curios.text: Whenever your discard pile is shuffled into your Library, a random waiting visitor gains +2 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Royal Goblet
curios.text: While a Distinguished Encounter's main visitor is waiting, draw 1 more book at the start of each turn.

curios.name: Sleepless Lantern
curios.text: Once per Encounter: if you fulfill 2 or more visitors in a turn, nobody loses Patience at the end of that turn.

curios.name: Queue Collapse Counter
curios.text: While 5 or more visitors are waiting, every 3rd book you assign costs 0 Actions.

curios.name: Crown of Command
curios.text: Books assigned to visitors who have a visitor ability gain +2 Value.

curios.name: Second Opinion
curios.text: If the last book assigned to a visitor was of your other Trait, the book you assign them now gains +2 Value. It can alternate again and again; a neutral book breaks that visitor's chain.

curios.name: Deep Waiting-Room Clock
curios.text: The first book assigned to a visitor each turn gains +1 Value for every 2 Patience they have, up to +2.

curios.name: Eye of the Beholder
curios.text: You can see the order of the books in your Library.

curios.name: Mirror
curios.text: When you gain this, choose a book in your deck: a copy of it joins your deck.

curios.name: Otherworldly Gift
curios.text: When you gain this, a random Rare book of a Trait outside your run's two joins your deck.

curios.name: The Great Alternating Index
curios.text: Every 3rd alternation in a row between your two Traits on paid assignments refunds 1 Action, and that book gains +2 Value. A neutral book breaks the chain.

curios.name: The Endless Waiting Room
curios.text: If you fulfill 2 or more visitors in a turn, everyone still waiting gains +1 Patience at the end of that turn instead of losing 1.

curios.name: Idol of the Pleased Patron
curios.text: Whenever you fulfill a visitor, every other waiting visitor gains +1 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Perfectly Balanced Inventory
curios.text: While your deck holds exactly as many books of one of your Traits as of the other, books of either Trait gain +2 Value. Neutral books are not counted.

curios.name: The Retinue's Book of Etiquette
curios.text: Whenever a new wave of visitors arrives, everyone already waiting gains +1 Fulfillment.

curios.name: Idol of Sacrifice
curios.text: Whenever a visitor's ability lowers a book's Value, or discards or DESTROYs one of your books, that book first gains +2 Value.

curios.name: Starweaved Dreamcatcher
curios.text: Every 5th visitor you fulfill gains you +1 Action at once.

curios.name: Twilight Key
curios.text: Treasures lay out 3 spoils instead of 2.

curios.name: The Crooked Hourglass
curios.text: In each Bookselling Encounter, the first visitor to arrive with more than 1 Patience arrives with −1 Patience.

curios.name: The Lead Bookmark
curios.text: The first assignment you pay Actions for in each Bookselling Encounter costs +1 Action.

curios.name: The Worm-Eaten Slip
curios.text: At the start of each Bookselling Encounter, one random book in your opening hand gets −1 Value for that Encounter.

curios.name: The Funeral Receipt
curios.text: The first walkout each Stage also costs 15 Gold.

curios.name: The Rusted Cashbox
curios.text: Every Merchant price is +15 Gold.

curios.name: The Moth-Eaten Map
curios.text: The first Finding each Stage gives no Gold.

curios.name: The Customs Stamp
curios.text: Taking a Treasure also costs 15 Gold.

curios.name: The Smudged Catalogue
curios.text: The first Summon you open each Stage reveals only 1 title instead of 3.

curios.name: The Warped Press
curios.text: The first Rebind you perform each Stage reveals only 1 Edition instead of 2.

curios.name: The Spoiled Ribbon
curios.text: The first book you take from a Summon each Stage gets −1 Value until the Stage ends.

curios.name: The Cracked Reliquary
curios.text: Curio Shrine offerings cost 11 / 18 / 28 / 41 Fragments instead of 8 / 15 / 25 / 38.

curios.name: The Jealous Idol
curios.text: The first positive Curio you gain each Stage is Dormant until the next Stage begins.

curios.name: The Greedy Saint
curios.text: Whenever you complete a Curio Shrine offering, it takes 3 more Curio Fragments after you choose your Curio.

encounters.name: Lantern Queue
encounters.purpose: Swarm: four small plain orders at once, then one late scout - the clean baseline. 8 / 8 / 6 / 4 / 2.

encounters.name: Closing Shift

encounters.name: Serious Readers

encounters.name: After the Lecture
encounters.purpose: Several people arriving in a compressed period - width, not weight. 4.5 / 9.5 / 10 / 3 / 3.

encounters.name: Pilgrims Below
encounters.purpose: A steady procession of the devout, one a turn. 4 / 7.5 / 7.2 / 7.7 / 3.7.

encounters.name: Dockworkers' Break

encounters.name: The Warlock's Retinue

intro.title: The Warlock
intro.line: Don't worry. I only eat the good ones.

intro.title: The Duchess
intro.line: Three husbands. Not one of them finished a book.

encounters.name: Freshly Exhumed

encounters.name: The Bone Sorters
encounters.purpose: Ambush: the Mason keeps every book and the Shaman shuffles junk in, then three arrive on turn 4. 9 / 9 / 9 / 19.3 / 13.3 / 4.3.

encounters.name: After-After Mass
encounters.purpose: Crowd: the deliberately wider Stage 2 Normal. 7.7 / 14.3 / 17.3 / 9.7 / 3.

encounters.name: The Hungry Dead
encounters.purpose: Swarm: one Hungry for Quiet zombie among small corpses, the big Groom later. 14.2 / 14.2 / 10.9 / 7.3 / 5.3 / 5.3.

encounters.name: Parish Registry
encounters.purpose: Procession: the Eager Dead Applicant first, then one applicant a turn. 4 / 10.5 / 15.8 / 15.3 / 9.3.

encounters.name: The Long Reading
encounters.purpose: Classic: two long projects, a quiet turn, two more; Slow Reader needs a strong book a turn. 9 / 9 / 17.5 / 12.5 / 8.5 / 8.5.

encounters.name: The Bone Exchange
